title: Marlowe Rewards Late Credit on Fulfilment-Order Points Credited After Dispatch
content:
**1. Late credit.** When Marlowe Rewards points are credited on a reservation fulfilment order that never earned them, a late credit is added for the wait since dispatch.

**2. Counting the wait.** The wait is counted in whole calendar days from the order's dispatch date to the handling date.

**3. Amount.**

| Wait since dispatch | Late credit |
|---|---|
| 45 days or more | 10 percent of the rounded points, itself rounded to the nearest whole point with a half point rounding up, and never less than 25 points |
| 14 to 44 days | a flat 15 points, whatever the size of the order |
| fewer than 14 days | nothing |

**4. Rounded points.** The rounded points are the points the order's qualifying spend earns on the adjustment, after rounding to a whole point. The late credit is added to them after that rounding.

## Worked cases (hypothetical orders)

| Rounded points | Days since dispatch | Late credit | Points credited |
|---|---|---|---|
| 380 | 50 | 10 percent of 380 is 38 | 418 |
| 255 | 45 | 25.5 rounds to 26 | 281 |
| 120 | 60 | 12 is below the floor, so 25 | 145 |
| 120 | 44 | 15 | 135 |
| 900 | 14 | 15 | 915 |
| 120 | 13 | nothing | 120 |
